messages.subject: Re: microclima and rgdal
parts:
Hi all, 

To anyone with a similar issue, I have managed to install "rgdal" by using an earlier version of R. Now "microclima" is installed and everything seems to be running well.

Thank you, 

Shane

On Wednesday, May 15, 2024 at 12:02:22 PM UTC+1 S King wrote:
Hi all, 

I am having trouble installing "microclima" due it's dependency on rgdal. Here's the error when using this code -

devtools::install_github('ilyamaclean/microclima')

 ERROR: dependencies 'rgdal', 'rnoaa' are not available for package 'microclima'
* removing 'C:/Users/shane/AppData/Local/R/win-library/4.4/microclima' Warning message: In i.p(...) : installation of package ‘C:/Users/shane/AppData/Local/Temp/Rtmpw9jGPF/file117043d134e2/microclima_0.1.0.tar.gz’ had non-zero exit status

I have tried to install archived versions of rgdal by downloading them, to which I get these errors when trying to install (using the following code) - 

install.packages("C:\\Users\\shane\\Downloads\\rgdal_1.6-7 (3).tar.gz")

ERROR: compilation failed for package 'rgdal' * removing 'C:/Users/shane/AppData/Local/R/win-library/4.4/rgdal' Warning in install.packages : installation of package ‘C:/Users/shane/DOWNLO~1/rgdal_1.6-7 (3).tar.gz’ had non-zero exit status

To add, I have the latest version of R and Rstudio.

If anyone has any solution to this so I can carry on with the model that would be greatly appreciated.

Thank you, 

Shane
